key_points.point: 3.1 The Need for Smaller Units Sonu’s mother was fixing a toy.
She was trying to join two pieces with the help of a screw.
Sonu was watching his mother with great curiosity.
His mother was unable to join the pieces.
His mother said that the screw was not of the right size.
She brought another screw from the box and was able to fix the toy.
But when he observed them closely, he saw they were of slightly different lengths.
Sonu was fascinated by how such a small difference in lengths could matter so much.
